title: Introduce Theme Mechanism
description:
Introduce a theme mechanism. The default theme is the semio theme. In os and playgrounds add a theme tab to settings side panel where premade themes can be selected, and customized. Add save and load mechanism. All tokens are editable in tree etc.

Approach (see full plan in ticket folder / conversation): rename the existing light/dark palette dimension from "theme" to "appearance" (freeing "theme" for this new concept); build a UiTheme model covering colors, spacing, fontStacks, canvasFonts, strokes, radii, opacities, metrics, and appearances (light/dark palette groups); extend runtime merge bridges beyond colors to all tokens; add a Theme settings tab (select premades semio+mono, edit every token in a tree, save/load custom themes via localStorage + .theme.json export/import) in the shared os-shell settings panel (covers os and playgrounds/studio since they share the same shell).
summary:
Fixed the reported bug: the 3D viewport didn't update when editing the theme's "primary" color. Root cause was three independent stale-listener bugs, none related to hardcoded colors or a disconnected Rust struct — the color resolvers themselves were already correct and CSS-var-driven:

1. framework/renderer/react/components/world-3d-host.tsx's `useSemanticColors` hook (drives 3D selection/hover material colors via --active-base → var(--color-primary)) had its own hand-rolled MutationObserver watching only `["data-ui-appearance", "class"]`. The theme-apply path (applyUiThemeToDocument) mutates the `style` attribute (via setProperty) and `data-ui-theme` dataset attribute — neither was in the watched list, so live primary-color edits never triggered a re-resolve. Fixed by replacing the bespoke observer with the shared `useCanvasAppearanceSync` hook (already used correctly by all 2D canvas hosts), which watches the full correct attribute set.

2. infinite/world/r3f/index.tsx's `WorldOrbitViewGizmo` (CAD axis gizmo) had the identical bug — its own MutationObserver watched only `["class"]` — plus its `labelColor` was frozen forever in a `useMemo` with an empty dependency array. Fixed the same way: swapped to `useCanvasAppearanceSync`, converted `labelColor` to state that updates alongside the axis colors.

3. Same file's `WorldLodGridHelper` resolved the ground grid line color inside a `useMemo` keyed only on LOD-related deps, so grid color changes were stuck until an unrelated LOD/zoom change happened to fire. Extracted the resolved grid color into its own state wired to `useCanvasAppearanceSync`, included it in the grid-rebuild memo's dependency array.

Not touched: cad/renderer/js/index.tsx has an even more severe version of this bug (a module-level color cache never reset in production code) but that renderer is not currently mounted anywhere in the app (confirmed via repo-wide grep), so it has zero live impact today — left as a known follow-up rather than fixed blind.

Verified via bun build of both changed files (clean), full os-shell.tsx build (clean, world-3d-host is lazy-loaded from there), and the framework-renderer-react vitest suite (71/71 passing, no regressions). Did not chase the large pile of pre-existing, unrelated Three.js/@types duplication type errors in these files under raw tsc — confirmed none of them reference the edited lines.
